plugins.name: cofounder
plugins.description: Building With Managed Agents, as a re-runnable protocol. Three plain verbs (continue / update / status) drive each week's tasks with mechanical checks that gate advancement and judgment rubrics that coach; reconciliation-first, so a rerun and a fresh install are the same path. Week 1 is the first release (nine tasks). Protocol only — all state lives in your own venture folder. v0.2.0, 2026-07-23. Early access: unreleased, gates pending.
